items.title: CTXAgent - Self-Controlled Context Management of LLM Agents
items.title_zh: CTXAgent：LLM 智能体的自控上下文管理
items.summary: CTXAgent lets the model manage its own context, deciding when to compact, what to keep and what hand-off to write with two tools and one paragraph of guidance, and evaluates seven frontier models on mixed sessions of 35–212 turns. Most strong models compact and curate regularly without significant benchmark-score loss, and with Claude Opus 5.5 the self-managed harness matches Claude Code on task success at 34% lower cost than its 200k-window configuration and 49% lower than its default.

items.title: EvolveMAS: A Unified Self-Evolution Framework for Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems
items.title_zh: EvolveMAS：去中心化多智能体系统的统一自我进化框架
items.summary: EvolveMAS pairs each main agent with a dedicated MemoryAgent that governs structured memory outside the reasoning context, supporting within-episode online adaptation and cross-episode knowledge evolution across cooperative, mixed-motive and adversarial settings. Across five benchmarks and six evaluation configurations it achieves the highest normalized average score of 77.2, and ablations show that both test-time memory governance and cross-episode reuse improve performance without updating model parameters.

items.title: From GPU to TPU with Coding Agents: What Works, What Fails, and What It Costs?
items.title_zh: 从 GPU 到 TPU 的编码智能体迁移：什么有效、什么失败、成本几何？
items.summary: The study uses Claude Code to migrate ten of 148 PyTorch research projects from NVIDIA GPUs to Google Cloud TPUs and independently checks whether each migration runs, preserves numerical behavior, executes on the intended hardware and maintains the project's goal. Eight projects meet the project-goal criterion with 2.4 human interventions on average, while 53 of 70 execution attempts fail and 26 of those failures raise no error.

items.title: DynaFlow: Learning Free-Form Multi-Agent Orchestration
items.title_zh: DynaFlow：学习自由形式的多智能体编排
items.summary: DynaFlow integrates free-form executable workflow synthesis into the main agent's action space, letting it decide when to collaborate and generate task-specific programs that coordinate fixed sub-agents sequentially or in parallel with verification. Trained only on distilled trajectories and refined on filtered examples, it reaches 88.08% overall accuracy in Forced mode across six benchmarks, 10.90 points above the strongest evaluated baseline with the same Qwen3.5-27B backbone.

items.title: AgentProofBench: Benchmarking Reusable Verifiers for Web Agents
items.title_zh: AgentProofBench：评测 Web 智能体可复用验证器的基准
items.summary: AgentProofBench connects paired tests of a frozen acceptance rule to execution from identical saved openings across 97 tasks, 79 families and four web services. Across 48 families, complete-panel and decision-replay tests retain 82/96 Flash and 79/96 Pro source programs, and deployment-state panel correctness separates assignments with both saved openings delivered correctly (32/33) from those with panel errors (1/11).

items.title: AndroidFlux: Evaluating and Reward Modeling Failure Recovery Capabilities in Mobile Use Multimodal Agents
items.title_zh: AndroidFlux：移动多模态智能体故障恢复能力的评测与奖励建模
items.summary: AndroidFlux restores recorded mobile-agent trajectories to controlled checkpoints before, at and after the first recoverable error so different agents continue from the same device state and history, paired with a reward-modeling benchmark using downstream rollout outcomes. Its evaluations show that recovery performance only partially correlates with clean-start success, and that explicit reasoning helps only models trained with GUI-domain-specific reinforcement learning.

items.title: Improving the Chain-of-Thought Compressibility of Pruned Reasoning Models via Long--Short Contrastive Pruning
items.title_zh: 通过长短对比剪枝提升剪枝推理模型的思维链可压缩性
items.summary: The paper proposes Contrastive Set-Difference, which identifies neurons enriched in redundant reasoning by contrasting activations on long and short correct solutions to the same problem, and extends preference pairs to problems a pruned model always or never solves. Pruning 20% of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B this way uses 8–22% fewer thinking tokens on four math benchmarks than reasoning-aware calibration followed by the same compression, with accuracy within 0.5 points.

items.title: Large Language Models: A Plain-Language Overview for Engineers
items.title_zh: 大语言模型：面向工程师的通俗综述
items.summary: This plain-language overview walks engineers through the transformer, pretraining, fine-tuning with reinforcement learning from human feedback, retrieval-augmented generation, chain-of-thought prompting and tool-using agents, plus efficiency techniques such as FlashAttention and QLoRA. It closes with a checklist for judging LLM evaluation claims that flags data contamination, LLM-as-a-judge grading, long context and hallucination.
